info.title: NetEvolve.FrameShift.Execution
info.description: A command-line tool that runs execution-based mutation verification: it mutates a compiled assembly, re-runs the referencing test project against every mutant, and reports the resulting mutation score.

options.name: --test-output
options.description:
The build output directory of the test project (contains the test
assembly, the production assembly and every dependency of both).

options.name: --production-dll
options.description:
The file name of the production assembly inside that directory,
e.g. MyApp.dll. Recompiled fresh from --source; the copy already in
the output directory is never read.

options.name: --test-dll
options.description: The file name of the test assembly inside that directory.

options.name: --source
options.description:
A production source file to compile and generate mutations from.
Repeatable.

options.name: --timeout-seconds
options.description:
How long to wait for the test host of a single mutant before it is
killed and the mutant is reported as timed out. Defaults to 60.

options.name: --report-format
options.description:
The format of the end-of-run report: 'console', 'html',
'markdown' or 'github-summary'. Defaults to 'console'.

options.name: --report-path
options.description:
The file the end-of-run report is written to. Required for
'html'; optional for 'console' and 'markdown', which write
to the console when omitted; ignored for 'github-summary', which always
appends to the file named by the GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY environment variable.
